newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria sets up an oil joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Algeria sets up an oil joint venture.

text.p: Algeria's state-owned oil and gas company Sonatrach has set up a 40-60 oil joint venture with U.S. oil explorer M-I Drillings Fluids, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Saturady.
The joint-venture M-I Algeria Spa will be based in Algeria's main oil producing Hassi Messaoud southern region, APS said.
The new firm would provide engineering services, finance services and trade chemical products to the oil fields in Algeria, it added.
The venture was officially agreed by the state-investement regulatory agency.

M-I Drillings Fluids, based in Texas, has a 60 percent share in the joint venture worth $4.5 million while Sonatrach has a 40 percent with an investment of 247.8 million dinar ($4.6 million), said APS.
